options.name: Of the Waves
options.description: Beng Lethonian is being on the sea. You gain +1 Athletics and you can hold your breath for twice as long.

options.name: Seawitch
options.description: The Lethonions are known for employ see witches to ease the passage across the abyss. Gain +1 Spell Damage and Learn 2 Beginner and 2 Novice Spells from the Aquamancy or Aeromancy schools of magic.

options.name: Acquired Immunity
options.description: Living in such close quarters has made you esspecially resilient to diseases. Gain +1 Resilience. When becoming diseased or poisoned, roll a 1d4. On a 4, you do not gain the condition.

options.name: Many Ports
options.description: Lethonians often grow up alongside many other cultures. Gain +1 Insight and Learn one non-magical Language

options.name: Sea Rat
options.description: Gain +1 Thievery Knowledge and learn the Duelist Stance
